title: Closing a Vehicle Purchase Agreements Deal
content:
**Closing rule.** A deal under the **Vehicle Purchase Agreements** is closed only from delivered status. It is closed only when its balance due is 0.00 and its deposit held is 0.00. A delivered deal that still carries a balance remains delivered and continues under the balance due and late balance fee rule. A credit balance below 0.00 is refunded to the buyer before closing.

| Deal status | Balance due | Deposit held | Outcome |
|---|---|---|---|
| delivered | 0.00 | 0.00 | may be closed |
| delivered | 312.40 | 0.00 | stays delivered; continues under the late balance fee rule |
| delivered | below 0.00 (a credit) | 0.00 | the credit is refunded to the buyer before closing |
| contracted | 0.00 | 0.00 | not closed: only a delivered deal is closed |

Figures in the table are hypothetical.
